Elon Musk has confirmed that Hardware 3 (HW3) in Tesla vehicles “cannot support unsupervised FSD.” In response, Tesla is offering discounted trade-ins toward AI4 vehicles, plus computer and camera upgrades for current owners.

For a longer-term solution across the fleet, the company plans to establish micro-factories in major metro areas to convert HW3 cars to HW4 hardware over time.
